title: Huang Tian at the Nine Serene Spring
summary: The Sky Mansion Alliance returns in triumph, and factions that suffered under the Hall of Souls rush to join it. Xiao Yan grieves that he failed to save Xiao Zhan again, and Yao Lao says he has sent men to find where Xiao Zhan is held. In seclusion, a bead left by the Void Devouring Flame drains Xiao Yan's fighting energy, so he gives it to Little Yi, who purifies it and gains the flame's devouring power. A letter then arrives from the Nine Serene Deep Ground Pythons. At the Nine Serene Spring, Huang Tian, clan leader of the Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe and a Five-Star Dou Sheng, demands that Yao Ming hand over Medusa, blaming Xiao Yan for taking his son and his clan's wings. Yao Ming refuses, and the Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe's Ancient Phoenix Formation breaks the pythons' Coiling Serpent Formation. Huang Tian says he has taken Medusa and that Xiao Yan must come to his clan to redeem her, just as Xiao Yan arrives.
events: The alliance returns in triumph and grows.
Xiao Yan grieves for Xiao Zhan; Yao Lao sends men to find him.

A Void Devouring Flame bead drains Xiao Yan's fighting energy.
Little Yi purifies the bead and gains its devouring power.
Huang Tian demands Medusa from Yao Ming at the Nine Serene Spring.
The Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe breaks the Coiling Serpent Formation.
Xiao Yan arrives as Huang Tian claims to have taken Medusa.
introduced: Huang Tian (clan leader, Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe)
cultivation: Huang Tian is a Five-Star Dou Sheng. Little Yi gains the Void Devouring Flame's devouring power. Xiao Yan notes that three months of cultivation have not brought his fighting energy up.
